card.name: Ends of life-threatening condition names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a serious condition name, such as the end of lactic acidosis, myxedema coma or hyperthermia, in warnings where death is likely to be mentioned next.

modes.label: Lactic acidosis
modes.description: The ending -osis of lactic acidosis in metformin warnings, just before a mention of death or fatal cases.
modes.example: WARNING: LACTIC ACIDOSIS Postmarketing cases of metformin-associated lactic acid<<osis>> have resulted in death, hypothermia

modes.label: Other severe conditions
modes.description: The final part of other grave condition names, such as myxedema coma or fatal hyperthermia.
modes.example: levothyroxine (T4) and liothyronine (T3) is suspected. Myxedema Coma Myxedema<< coma>> is usually precipitated in the hypothy

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about death, such as fatal, deadly and mortality.
card.plain: It fires on the end of a serious condition's name when the text is about to say it can be fatal.
